summary: The XV BRICS Summit declaration outlining strategic partnerships, with specific commitments to anti-corruption, asset recovery, and financial system reform.

priority_areas: Investigation, prosecution, and recovery of stolen assets
Mutual legal assistance and information-sharing networks
anti_corruption_commitments.capacity_building: Conducting training programmes and sharing best practices among BRICS members.

financial_system_reforms.local_currencies: Encouraging the use of local currencies in international trade and financial transactions to reduce reliance on global reserve currencies.
financial_system_reforms.payment_systems: BRICS Payment Task Force (BPTF) mapping cross-border payment interlinking.
financial_system_reforms.correspondent_banking: Strengthening networks between BRICS central banks for local currency settlements.

security_and_ict.cybercrime: Support for a comprehensive UN convention on countering the use of ICTs for criminal purposes.
security_and_ict.counter_terrorism: Combating terrorism financing networks and safe havens under the BRICS Counter-Terrorism Strategy.

geopolitical_context: Call for reform of Bretton Woods institutions (IMF/World Bank) to increase representation of emerging markets and developing countries (EMDCs).
